description: M16 STALKER-inspired anomaly hazards + artifact loot table. 6 anomaly types + 20+ artifact entries. Each anomaly has spawn rules / detection requirements / hazard mechanic / artifact drop chance. Each artifact has passive bonus + bonus tradeoff. Per DR-016 narrative + M16 hazard package + STALKER series prior art.

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: actors within active radius pulled toward center at 8 m/s; mass-scaled (lighter actors pulled stronger); projectiles curve into well
anomalies.visual_cue: bent-light distortion ring + falling debris orbiting center
anomalies.audio_cue: low-frequency hum + bass thump on actor capture
anomalies.counter_mechanic: anti-gravity grenade temporarily disrupts well; jet-pack escape if quick

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: ongoing electric arcs strike actors within radius every 2-4s; each arc deals shock + stun affliction (3s); damages electronics + drains battery on robots
anomalies.visual_cue: cyan + white arcs leaping between bare metal protrusions; air shimmer
anomalies.audio_cue: buzzing electrical hum + sharp crack on arc strikes
anomalies.counter_mechanic: ground-strap on suit; insulator suit fully blocks; faraday cage shelter

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: actors within radius experience time dilation — perceived motion speed +200% (faster movements) BUT actual game-tick time normal; high vertigo + nausea affliction; mass acceleration risks broken bones from sudden moves
anomalies.visual_cue: warbling chromatic-aberration distortion + clockwise spiral effect
anomalies.counter_mechanic: anti-vertigo serum + walk slowly + escape on prediction

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: puddle of unstable acid-amalgam; touching it deals acid burn + poison; vapor cloud causes lung damage in 4m above pool
anomalies.visual_cue: green-yellow shimmering puddle + bubbling + amber vapor rising
anomalies.counter_mechanic: hazmat suit + sealed boots; neutralizer thrown into pool

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: ongoing psychic disturbance affects organic actors — visual hallucinations + reduced accuracy + occasional brief sanity break; affects insectoid + heavy_biomech LESS; robots immune
anomalies.visual_cue: screen-edge wisps + distant whispering text overlays + occasional ghostly figures
anomalies.audio_cue: inner-ear whispers + radio static + indistinct voices

anomalies.hazard_mechanic: spawns 1-3 stealth predator entities (bloodsucker creatures); ambush actors at low light; consume blood resource on hit
anomalies.visual_cue: thicket of bone-piles + blood stains on ground + faint heat shimmer where invisible predator stands
anomalies.audio_cue: low growl + breathing audio when bloodsucker is nearby (positional)
anomalies.counter_mechanic: infrared scope reveals stealthed creatures; loud noise scares them off; explosive scatters them

artifacts.passive_bonus: Reduce gravity effect on wearer by 30%; jet-pack thrust +20%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Acquire +0.5 vertigo per minute when not in jet-flight (sanity tradeoff)
artifacts.visual_cue: small dark-purple crystalline gem with starlight refraction
artifacts.lore: Forged from gravity-well center mass; lighter than air but emits a faint pull on nearby objects.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Carry weight cap +25%; movement speed -10%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Fall damage +50% from heights > 4m
artifacts.visual_cue: smooth black marble that visibly bends light around it
artifacts.lore: Compressed mass from gravity-well center; weighs as much as 8 kilos of steel.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Throw to create temporary 4m gravity well at target location (60s cooldown)
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Passive radiation emission affects wearer + 1m radius (slow accumulation)
artifacts.visual_cue: pulsing dark sphere with gravitational distortion ring
artifacts.lore: Concentrated singularity fragment; throw it to pull enemies + projectiles into a collapsing field.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Suit battery recharge rate +200%; auto-resupplies power for held electrical weapons
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Electrical resistance -20%; faraday cage materials repel wearer
artifacts.visual_cue: cyan-glowing capacitor with copper coiling
artifacts.lore: Captures electrical discharges + stores them indefinitely; useful in storm zones.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Shocked affliction duration reduced by 50%; electrical damage taken -25%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Wearer's electronics drain 30% faster (helmet displays, comm radio)
artifacts.visual_cue: small lightning-bolt-shaped charm on copper chain
artifacts.lore: Cast in lightning-strike sand fused around copper core; deflects electrical hits.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Reload speed +30%; weapon swap time -50%; sprint +15%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Stamina regen -20%; aging slightly accelerated (cosmetic gray hairs over time)
artifacts.visual_cue: fractured clockwork gear with shifting numerals
artifacts.lore: Forged from time-warp residue; manipulates personal time at the cost of natural lifespan.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Trap detection range +50%; lock-picking speed +50%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Unable to wear during emergency-extract (slows extraction)
artifacts.visual_cue: delicate brass gear with hand-wound mainspring
artifacts.lore: Pre-collapse engineer's masterwork; reveals mechanical structure of nearby objects.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Acid resistance +60%; acid weapons deal +30% damage
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Pearl slowly corrodes wearer's armor over time (-1% armor integrity per hour)
artifacts.visual_cue: iridescent green pearl with internal bubbling
artifacts.lore: Crystallized from acid pool center; pulses with corrosive energy.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Throw to dissolve enemy armor at impact point (-25% armor for 30s)
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Single-use; cannot be combined with other thrown items in same throw
artifacts.visual_cue: amber gel-globule in glass capsule
artifacts.lore: Distilled corrosive amalgam from chemical pools.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Psy-storm resistance +75%; insanity affliction stacks reduced by 1 per minute
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Wearer hears faint whispers periodically (cosmetic flavor; no gameplay effect)
artifacts.visual_cue: silver disk with engraved spiral + glowing center
artifacts.lore: Bound to a fragmented mind; shields the wearer from psychic disturbance.

artifacts.passive_bonus: When player HP < 25%, summon a single 'phantom guardian' actor for 30s (combat-capable; non-persistent)
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Cooldown 10 minutes between summons; consumes 1 mana / blood / power per second while guardian active
artifacts.visual_cue: small wooden idol with carved eyes and ritual markings
artifacts.lore: Pre-collapse shamanic artifact; channels the wearer's vital essence into a temporary defender.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Melee damage +40%; bleed inflicted on victims +1 stack per hit
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Carrier emits faint blood-scent; bloodsucker spawn-rate near wearer +30%
artifacts.visual_cue: curved white fang with crimson-tipped point
artifacts.lore: Razor-edged tooth from a bloodsucker; the carrier draws bloodsucker attention.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Blood regeneration +50%; wounds coagulate 2x faster
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Wearer attracts bloodsucker scent +20%; small wound count on wearer +1 over carry duration
artifacts.visual_cue: deep crimson marble that visibly absorbs blood when held to bleeding wounds
artifacts.lore: Bloodsucker territory marker; transfers vital essence to the carrier.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Weapon condition degradation -50%; jam-recovery 2x faster
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: None (universal common artifact)
artifacts.visual_cue: small amber vial labeled in 4 languages
artifacts.lore: Standard issue across most factions; the practical anti-corrosion compound.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Critical hit chance +5% on weapons; loot drop quality tier +1 (rare items more common)
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Random per-session: 5% chance of weapon jam on first shot
artifacts.visual_cue: weathered ivory d12 with worn numerals
artifacts.lore: Gambler's tool; rumored to be fortune-bound.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Pain affliction resistance +75%; stunned duration -50%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Stamina recovery -10%
artifacts.visual_cue: small iron coin with stamped fist symbol
artifacts.lore: Coalition combat-stim token; psychologically reduces pain perception.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Cold resistance +75%; cryogenic affliction blocked at stack 1
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Heat affliction +25% vulnerability
artifacts.visual_cue: pale blue pearl with internal frost crystals
artifacts.lore: Crystallized super-cooled water from a Europa subsurface vent.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Heat resistance +75%; burning affliction reduced by 1 stack per 5s
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Cold affliction +25% vulnerability
artifacts.visual_cue: deep red pearl that glows faintly with internal fire
artifacts.lore: Solidified flame fragment from a Vulcan magma vent.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Triple-tap scope: holding zoom for 1.5s gives 3x zoom + reveals enemy weak points
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Wearer cannot use other optics (binoculars, scopes block out)
artifacts.visual_cue: obsidian lens in copper frame with tiny ritual etching
artifacts.lore: Forged from gravity-well-condensed glass; sees through hidden surfaces.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Sprint speed +15%; jump height +20%; fall damage -30%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Stamina drain +10%; carrying capacity -10%
artifacts.visual_cue: small green pebble that briefly glows when wearer moves quickly
artifacts.lore: Mimas surface stone; resonates with kinetic motion.

artifacts.passive_bonus: Footstep audio reduced by 80%; stealth detection range -40%
artifacts.passive_tradeoff: Running speed -10% (more careful walking)
artifacts.visual_cue: boots with felt soles + faded faction patch
artifacts.lore: Ronin scout-grade equipment; the wearer moves as a whisper.
